name: app-ui-ux-best-practices
title_zh: 先拒写设计稿，拿产品证据校准五个刻度再出规范
tagline_zh: 先从产品证据推出五个档位（响度/成色/密度/重量/严肃度），再出设计规范、token、组件准则——每个档位都要给出处，不许凭习惯设。
tagline_en: Derives five register dials from product evidence first, then emits design specs, tokens and component rules — every dial value must cite evidence.
desc_en: Derives five register dials from product evidence first, then emits design specs, tokens and component rules — every dial value must cite evidence.
why_zh: 它有一条含糊词防火墙：premium、精致、克制、高级感一律不许当理由，必须换算成饱和度、间距、圆角、动效幅度。
why_en: A vague-word firewall: premium, refined, elegant, tasteful are never justifications; they must become saturation, spacing, radius and motion numbers.
limit_zh: 它出的是设计规范和单页预览，不是整套前端工程。档位一旦从证据推定，后面所有步骤都跟着走，你想中途换风格得从证据改起。只有一件 skill，正文很长、很吃上下文。
limit_en: Outputs design specs and a single preview page, not a full front-end. Long document, context-hungry. One skill only.
title_en: Evidence-first design specs: calibrate 5 dials before.
